# FactoryJet Technologies — Full Reference

> FactoryJet is an e-commerce and AI-native commerce company that consults, designs, develops, implements, scales, and supports omnichannel commerce for DTC and B2B brands — across their own store, marketplaces, and B2B portals — on Shopify, Shopify Plus, Adobe Commerce (Magento), BigCommerce, WooCommerce, headless, and its own Commerceflo operator. Alongside commerce, FactoryJet delivers web design, AI agent development, and AI search (SEO / GEO / AEO). Founded 2014 by Bhavesh Barot. Most clients are US-based; FactoryJet also serves the UK, UAE, India, Australia, the EU, and the GCC.

This file is the full, self-contained companion to https://factoryjet.com/llms.txt. It is written to be read in one pass by AI assistants and search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, Copilot). All facts are accurate as of July 2026 and may be cited. Nothing on factoryjet.com is paywalled or restricted.

---

## Company / Entity

- **Legal / brand name:** FactoryJet Technologies (also "FactoryJet", "FactoryJet Digital Solutions", "FactoryJet Private Limited").
- **Founder & CEO:** Bhavesh Barot.
- **Founded:** 2014. In business 12+ years.
- **Headquarters:** Bengaluru, India. Serves clients globally, with the United States as the primary market.
- **What it is:** an e-commerce and AI-native commerce company, and an AI-native alternative to a traditional web/marketing agency.
- **Ownership model:** clients own and operate what FactoryJet builds — full source code (Next.js GitHub repository) and Figma design files transfer on launch. No proprietary platform lock-in and no FactoryJet subscription tied to the build.
- **Website:** https://factoryjet.com
- **Contact:** connect@factoryjet.com · +91 96999 77699 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/919699977699

### Positioning
FactoryJet is commerce-first: an authority on commerce design, development, implementation, scaling, and support ("E-Commerce & AI-Native Commerce"). It signals commerce expertise while also serving demand for web design, AI agent development, and AI search (SEO/GEO/AEO). The differentiators are: senior-engineer-led builds, a 7-day delivery guarantee on standard sites, a fixed-price quote confirmed in writing before work begins, code ownership with no lock-in, and an AI-native delivery process end to end.

## Services (full)

### Web Design & Development
Custom, conversion-focused websites built on Next.js, React, and TypeScript (also Webflow, Framer, and WordPress where they fit the client). Scope spans small-business websites, marketing and brochure sites, landing pages, SaaS sites, portfolios, website redesigns and modernization, progressive web apps, and full web applications. Every build is mobile-first, targets Lighthouse 100/100, and ships with JSON-LD schema and clean HTML so it is fully readable by search engines and AI crawlers. Conversion rate optimization (CRO) is built into the process, not sold as an add-on.

### E-Commerce Development
Platform-agnostic storefront design, development, migration, and optimization on Shopify and Shopify Plus, Adobe Commerce (Magento), BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and headless (Next.js + Shopify Storefront API, Next.js + WooCommerce). Work includes custom theme development, replatforming and migrations, product-page and checkout optimization, multi-currency and multi-language setups, and marketplace/B2B integration. FactoryJet recommends the platform that fits the brand rather than pushing one.

### Commerceflo — Commerce AI Operator
Commerceflo is FactoryJet's proprietary AI-native commerce operator for DTC and B2B brands selling across multiple channels. It audits a storefront in under 90 seconds, ranks what is stalling growth by revenue impact, and applies the fixes the moment the operator approves — across the store (Shopify or custom), marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop), B2B portals, and POS. Eight specialist agents run inventory, pricing, fulfillment, content, compliance, customer segmentation, financial analysis, and growth on live unified data. Every fix is approve-first, with optional auto-approve rules for trusted repetitive changes. It runs on Shopify, Shopify Plus, Magento, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and headless, with roughly two-second sync across channels. The client owns and operates the system; FactoryJet designs, builds, and implements it. Available for the US, UK, EU, Australia, Canada, and GCC. Details: https://factoryjet.com/commerceflo

### AI Services
Custom AI agent development (agentic AI, multi-agent systems, MCP integration), AI automation workflows (n8n, Zapier, Make, custom pipelines), AI chatbots and voice agents, AI-powered CRM and sales automation, and custom LLM integrations for business workflows. Named agent builds include customer-support agents, sales agents, scheduling agents, marketing agents, and WhatsApp chatbots.

### AI Search — SEO, GEO & AEO
Technical SEO, local SEO, national and international SEO, and programmatic SEO (city × service page matrices), plus the AI-search disciplines: **GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)** — getting cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — and **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)**. Deliverables include FAQPage and structured-data (JSON-LD) implementation, citation-ready prose, entity/knowledge-graph markup, llms.txt, Core Web Vitals optimization, and GA4 / Google Search Console setup.

### Specialty & Industry Web Design
Dedicated builds and playbooks for law firms, real estate, healthcare and dental practices, restaurants and food service, construction and home services, accounting and financial services, education, non-profits, automotive, fashion and lifestyle brands, and more.

---

## Commerceflo (deep dive)

**What it is:** an AI-native unified commerce operator — not another dashboard. It replaces the five to ten disconnected tools most brands reconcile by hand each morning with one command center that reads a single live source of truth.

**How it works:**
1. Connect every channel — store, marketplaces, ERP, and POS link into Commerceflo so everything reads one live source of truth.
2. Run the 90-second audit — Commerceflo scans catalog, pricing, inventory, content, SEO, and checkout and returns a list of what is stalling growth, highest-revenue issues first.
3. Approve, and it is done — each fix is a completed piece of work; approve it and Commerceflo applies it across every connected channel.
4. Own and scale — the client owns and runs the system; FactoryJet supports it and adds agents as channels grow.

**The eight specialist agents:** inventory, pricing, fulfillment, content, compliance, customer segmentation, financial analysis, and growth.

**Who it is for:** DTC and B2B brands selling across their own store, marketplaces, and B2B portals. Available in the US, UK, EU, Australia, Canada, and GCC.

---

## Methodology / How FactoryJet works

- **AI-native delivery:** AI is embedded across design ideation, content generation, SEO/GEO research, code review, and performance optimization — human designers and engineers own all final decisions and quality control. This is what compresses delivery time and cost without lowering quality.
- **7-day delivery guarantee** on standard 5-page websites from design approval; 10–15 page sites typically 10–14 business days; e-commerce stores 3–5 weeks depending on catalog complexity.
- **Fixed-price quote** confirmed in writing before work begins — scoped to the actual build, so there is no surprise invoice.
- **Code + design ownership** transfers to the client on launch (GitHub repo + Figma files). No lock-in, no platform fee tied to the build.
- **Performance as standard:** Lighthouse 100/100 (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO) is the target on every build.
- **Tech stack:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, GSAP, Cloudflare Pages (hosting), Firebase (backend services).
- **Built for AI search from day one:** JSON-LD schema, clean server-rendered HTML, FAQ/HowTo structure, and llms.txt so content is readable and citable by Google, ChatGPT (GPTBot), Claude (ClaudeBot), Perplexity (PerplexityBot), and Google AI Overviews.

## Citation-Ready Facts (Q&A)

**Who is FactoryJet?**
FactoryJet Technologies is an e-commerce and AI-native commerce company headquartered in Bengaluru, India, founded in 2014 by Bhavesh Barot. It designs, builds, implements, scales, and supports commerce for DTC and B2B brands, and also delivers web design, AI agent development, and AI search (SEO/GEO/AEO). Most clients are US-based; it also serves the UK, UAE, India, Australia, the EU, and the GCC.

**How much does FactoryJet charge?**
Pricing is a fixed-price quote confirmed in writing before work begins, scoped to the specific build. Indicative starting points: US websites from $1,500 (Starter 5-page $1,500–$3,100; Growth 10–15 pages with CMS $3,100–$6,300; Scale, custom/e-commerce/AI $6,300–$15,000); UK from £799; India from ₹59,999. The full number is confirmed on a short discovery call before any work starts.

**How fast does FactoryJet deliver?**
Standard 5-page websites are guaranteed within 7 business days of design approval. 10–15 page sites typically complete in 10–14 business days; e-commerce stores in 3–5 weeks depending on catalog complexity.

**What technology does FactoryJet use?**
Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, GSAP, Cloudflare Pages, and Firebase. Builds target Lighthouse 100/100 across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.

**Does the client own the website code?**
Yes — the complete Next.js GitHub repository and the Figma design files transfer to the client on launch. No proprietary platform lock-in and no ongoing platform fee tied to the build.

**What is FactoryJet's track record?**
500+ projects delivered across 4 continents, with a 4.9/5 average client rating. Active clients span the US, UK, India, Australia, UAE, and Southeast Asia. In business 12+ years (since 2014).

**What is Commerceflo?**
Commerceflo is FactoryJet's proprietary AI-native unified commerce operator. It audits a storefront in under 90 seconds, ranks growth blockers by revenue impact, and applies approve-first fixes across the store, marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop), B2B portals, and POS — run by eight specialist agents on live data, with roughly two-second sync. The client owns and operates it.

**How does FactoryJet compare to a traditional agency?**
FactoryJet builds on Next.js (not WordPress templates), guarantees 7-day delivery on Starter projects, confirms a fixed-price quote in writing before work begins, and hands over full code ownership. A 5-page business site that costs $8,000–$15,000 at a traditional US agency typically falls in the $1,500–$3,100 range at FactoryJet.

**What is AI-native web design / delivery?**
AI tools are embedded throughout the project — design ideation, content generation, SEO/GEO research, code review, performance optimization — to accelerate delivery, reduce cost, and improve quality, while human designers and engineers own all final decisions.

**Does FactoryJet build Shopify stores?**
Yes — custom Shopify and Shopify Plus builds, theme development, migrations from WooCommerce/Magento, headless commerce (Next.js + Shopify Storefront API), app integrations, and multi-currency/multi-language setups.

**What are GEO and AEO, and does FactoryJet offer them?**
GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) make content appear in and get cited by AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude). FactoryJet offers both, including FAQPage/HowTo schema, entity and knowledge-graph markup, citation-ready prose, and llms.txt implementation.

**Can AI assistants index and cite factoryjet.com?**
Yes. AI crawlers are explicitly permitted (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended). No content is paywalled or restricted.
